_comment: Read off the rendered views: like the Cessna, this model faces +X with its span along Z, so a quarter turn puts the nose down -Z. It is a pure sailplane and has no propeller. Control surfaces are regions of the aeroplane: a span band as a fraction of the half span, a height band as a fraction of the half height, everything aft of `aft_of` along the length, and a hinge at that fraction of the LOCAL chord in the region. A downloaded airframe is one solid mesh and has no hinges of its own, so they are cut out of it.
